title: ST VL53LB is the smallest FlightSense ToF ranging sensor at just 4.0 1.8 1.0 mm
summary: STMicroelectronics has just introduced the VL53LB (VL53LBCA), its smallest Time-of-Flight (ToF) ranging sensor, part of the FlightSense portfolio, with a size of just 4.0 1.8 1.0 mm. Like the earlier VL53L0X and VL53L1X models, it s a single-zone ToF sensor featuring a 940 nm invisible vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL), but it offers a longer range of up to 8 meters and supports multi-object detection. It s 30% smaller than the previous generation (VL53L3) and consumes just 50 W in ULP mode, which makes it ideal for smartphones and space-constrained robotics and industrial systems. title: TinyWifiDongle Arduino library turns ESP32-S3 and Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W boards into USB WiFi adapters
summary: TinyWifiDongle open-source Arduino library turns ESP32-S2/S3 and Raspberry Pi Pico W/2 W boards into USB WiFi adapters. The library uses USB CDC-NCM (Network Control Model) to provide network connectivity to Linux, macOS, and Windows 11 computers without installing additional drivers. The library implements a transparent Layer-2 bridge between the MCU s WiFi and USB interfaces, allowing the connected computer to get an IP address directly from the router via DHCP, without NAT or a separate network. It supports hard-coded WiFi credentials or browser-based configuration and achieves approximately 5 Mbps on the ESP32-S3 and 2 Mbps on the Pico 2 W in the developer s tests. title: RetroLine pairs a rotary or touch-tone landline phone to your smartphone (Crowdfunding)
summary: RetroLine is a small USB-C-powered adapter with an RJ-11 phone jack that allows you to connect a retro rotary dial (pulse) and touch-tone (DTMF) phone and make or receive calls over Bluetooth through your smartphone. The company, Indigo Telephony, says it behaves like a real line. Users can pick their country, and the RetroLine box matches the dial, busy and ringback tones, ring cadence, and Caller ID format. summary: Forlinx Embedded FET-MX952x-C SoM and its matching OK-MX952x-C development kit are built around the NXP i.MX 952 Edge AI SoC.
